source_evidence.boundary: Extract system logic only. Never reproduce LE LABO wording, label grid, scent-number naming, city/name/date personalization, bottle-as-door composition, house/travel collage or exact trade dress.

vessel_record.design_intent: A batch-recorded cultured-food vessel, not a logo-bearing pantry jar and not a perfume replica.

form.closure: plain low graphite anodized-aluminum overcap over a removable full-perimeter seal; no decorative motif and no exposed perfume hardware

vessel_record.material: premium optically clear heavy glass food-vessel candidate with plausible refraction; no plastic cues and no food-contact performance claim

print.method: one neutral-black direct print on clear glass, no individual paper label or opaque backing
print.composition: left-aligned narrow record column; product name leads, brand is smaller; one 0.5-point vertical rule and restrained baselines, not a pharmacy grid
print.variable_data_rule: Only verified regulatory and actual batch data may populate the variable zone. No fake city, customer, compounded-on or prepared-for fields.
print.reverse_mark: one 15–18 mm recipe-specific Material Plate micro-mark at lower rear; full editorial engraving stays off the primary front

photo_lock.camera: straight-on authoritative front, 10-degree downward elevation, 85 mm equivalent, centered
photo_lock.lighting: soft upper-left key, restrained frontal fill, two black flags for glass edges, grounded down-right contact shadow

material_folios.style: fine monochrome copperplate etching and stipple with modern editorial collage logic

palette.spot_color_rule: brand/founder/process are monochrome; ingredient plates may use one translucent 5–8% actual-ingredient tint only in preparation or finished trace

material_folios.composition: 65–70% negative space, one dominant real MORA object or tool group, exactly one impossible material transition, no text inside artwork
material_folios.surface: clean contemporary paper field without deckled edge, foxing, stains, sepia or faux aging
material_folios.line_behavior: fine cross-hatching, restrained stipple, coherent single engraving light, crisp contours with midtone detail
prohibited: house plus bottle plus suitcase collage
LE LABO product silhouette or wording

narrative_assets.name: The First Furrow
narrative_assets.job: brand origin; one spoon furrow becomes a path through scale, filter cloth and ingredient states

narrative_assets.name: The Table Before the Product
narrative_assets.job: founder factual-gate image; an empty worktable with scale, filter, notebook, one first ingredient and one vessel, no invented portrait

narrative_assets.name: From Cloth to Body
narrative_assets.job: manufacturing story; filter cloth becomes topography, whey a descending river and concentrate a retained landform

material_folios.founder_boundary: Until verified founder facts and image rights exist, show the question, tools, archive and worktable only. Never caption a generated person or invented scene as the founder.

wave_a: exact vector Vessel Record print specification

wave_a_approvals.approval_method: local original-detail image inspection, deterministic SVG render inspection, static file/schema checks; no browser automation

orchestration.wave_b_gate: Freeze and visually approve the Wave A masters internally before all dependent generations.
